subject: general
question: Which Indian government body is primarily responsible for monitoring and regulating the Air Quality Index (AQI) in India?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)**__.

**__Key Points__**

• The **Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)** is a statutory organization under the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)**. It is the primary body responsible for monitoring and regulating the **National Air Quality Index (AQI)** across **India**. *Hence, this option is correct.*

• The **AQI** was launched by the **Prime Minister** in **September 2014** as part of the **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** to provide a **One Number-One Color-One Description** system for the public to judge air quality easily.

• The **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** is responsible for health policy and administration in **India** but does not directly monitor or regulate environmental air quality indices. *Hence, this statement is incorrect.*
